blocks.text: Denzel Washington and Robert Pattinson are teaming up for a high-stakes bank robbery in the upcoming heist thriller “The Take.” Netflix unveiled the first look on Monday, Nov. 9, featuring Washington and Pattinson alongside co-star Daisy Edgar-Jones in the film directed by Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Fernando Meirelles, best known for “City of God” and “The Two Popes.” The story follows Noah (Pattinson), a former Army captain struggling to adjust to civilian life after leaving the military. He is then recruited by master thief Christian Carter (Washington) to join his crew in robbing Manhattan’s richest bank. However, their planned heist faces a […]...
